versions.changelog:
Major release with expanded browser automation features and better error recovery:

- Added multi-browser support (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) with automatic failover.
- Introduced robust error recovery, including automatic retry logic with exponential backoff.
- Implemented screenshot verification after actions for visual confirmation.
- Enhanced web scraping integration using CSS/XPath selectors and data transformation.
- Added CAPTCHA detection and solutions, plus improved anti-detection (proxies, user agents, viewport randomization).
- Expanded documentation and best practices for automation, debugging, and stealth.
